profile.headline: Software Engineer at Abridge
profile.summary:
Platform engineer focused on large-scale refactoring, observability, and tracing across distributed systems.

I started out building data-driven models and visualization apps for clients in finance, science, and industry, then spent several years as a developer at startups before moving into the systems work I do now: making sprawling distributed codebases more maintainable, performant, and easier to debug in production.
